text:
mona: Heads-up — customer saw duplicate records after a 429 during streaming attach. Looks like resume requests dropped the original Idempotency-Key.

raj: Which SDK/version?

mona: Rust SDK 0.2.0 and Go 0.9.1 tested. Rust resume code wasn't copying headers.

tess: Can you paste a minimal log?

mona: ```
[stream] chunk=10 acked
[stream] WARN 429 TooManyRequests
[stream] retry attempt=1 resume_token=rt-9 headers={}
[stream] INFO new_upload id=up-998
```

sam: Oof. Suggestion: stash op_id/idempotency on stream object at start and reapply on resume. Also restrict auto-replay for non-idempotent endpoints to single attempt.

raj: Agree. Standardize on full-jitter backoff across SDKs. Tiny snippet for docs: ```js
function backoffMs(attempt, base=100, cap=10000){
  return Math.floor(Math.random() * Math.min(cap, base * Math.pow(2, attempt)));
}
```

tess: I'll own the Rust patch + unit test. Sam, can you add a sample-app e2e that simulates mid-stream 429 and asserts no duplicates?

sam: Yup; will also add a README blurb about generating stable Idempotency-Key per logical operation.

replay-bot: [automated] created issue DEX-4511: "Resume flow drops Idempotency-Key -> duplicate stream uploads" assigned to tess

mona: Thanks — let's canary against the customer's workspace before rolling. :thumbsup:
